title: Optimal Quantum Algorithms for Ordered Search
summary: Ordered search is the problem of locating a target element in a sorted list of size $n$ using comparison queries. Classically, binary search requires $\lceil \log_2 n\rceil$ queries, which is optimal. Quantum algorithms offer a constant-factor speedup, but the precise constant has been a longstanding open question. We close this gap by exhibiting two new quantum algorithms for ordered search, each using the optimal $\frac{1}π\ln n+o(\log n)$ queries.
